summary: Comprehensive smoke test of Admin Panel (/admin) stability for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All 8 admin tabs render without errors or runtime crashes. Edit journey form opens/closes cleanly with AI description generation feature available. User and contribution management tabs display correct data.

code_quality_issues.issue: HTML hydration warnings - <tr> inside <span> and <span> inside <tbody> nesting issues
code_quality_issues.impact: No runtime impact, React development warning only

passed_tests: Admin login works with admin@4luis.com / Admin1
Admin panel /admin loads without errors
Dashboard/Stats section shows correct numbers: 9 Users, 5 Viagens, 0 Pending
Viagens tab: lists all 5 journeys (China, Japão, Vietname, Paris, Londres)
Viagens tab: each journey shows name, poetic name, amount raised, goal amount
Viagens tab: can click edit on a journey and the edit form expands inline
Viagens tab: edit form shows all fields - Informações Básicas, Objetivos Financeiros, Textos e Descrições
Viagens tab: edit form shows 'Descrições de Contribuição' section
Viagens tab: 'Gerar com IA' button present with data-testid='generate-ai-descriptions-btn'
Viagens tab: can close/cancel editing without errors
Utilizadores tab: shows user dashboard with Platform Momentum Score
Utilizadores tab: displays 9 total users with level distribution (Curioso/Sonhador/Premium)
Utilizadores tab: shows growth metrics (A crescer?), impact metrics (Impacto real?), top sponsors (Quem puxa?)
Contribuições tab: lists contributions with amount (€10), status (Pendente), payment reference (CN-XXXX)
Contribuições tab: search by payment reference input works with 'Pesquisar' button
Contribuições tab: shows 'Confirmar' and 'Rejeitar' action buttons for each contribution
Tab switching: All 8 tabs (Viagens, Candidaturas, Visibilidade, Contribuições, Utilizadores, Sorteios, Sponsors, Configurações) render without crash
Responsive: Admin panel adapts correctly to tablet viewport (768x1024)
Responsive: Admin panel adapts correctly to mobile viewport (390x844)
No major console errors or runtime crashes when switching between tabs
action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix HTML element nesting in Admin.js to eliminate React hydration warnings (tr/span nesting)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: HTML structure has <tr> inside <span> which causes React hydration warnings, should be restructured for proper HTML semantics
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seed data (5 journeys, 9 users, contributions with CN-XXXX references)
